items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the guy’s name was Jacoby. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Herb Jacoby.

ctx.x: Alec, after that, got us an audition at the Blue Angel in New York City which was run by Max Gordon who eventually owned the Village Vanguard, and the guy’s name was Jacoby.
Herb Jacoby. We used to call him the East Side General DeGaulle.
